svg.title: Feedforward uses the setpoint, not the measurement
svg.desc: Animated. Top: a speed-time graph drawn left to right. The dashed blue plan, the profile's setpoint speed, is a clean trapezoid: exact and on time. The solid orange measured speed is the same shape but wobbly and a little later: noisy and late. Bottom: a diagram. The plan feeds the feedforward block, marked with a green check; the measured speed is stopped before it with a red cross. Feedforward and feedback (PID) are added to give the volts, and dots flow along the arrows. WPILib: add feedforward and feedback, and compute feedforward from the setpoint.
svg.text: Feedforward uses the setpoint, not the measurement
Feed it the profile's planned speed and acceleration, not the measured ones.

g.text: the plan: exact and on time

svg.text: WPILib: add feedforward and feedback, and compute feedforward from the
setpoint. Measured values are noisy and late; the plan is exact and on time.
